description: sandbox_executor lacks a CI package import-cycle ratchet to prevent cross-layer dependency cycle regressions.
goal: Add a fast AST-based package import-cycle ratchet test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py that scans apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/ top-level subpackages, locks the current baseline cycle edge counts in the live repository, fails CI if any new package import cycle is introduced or any existing cycle's edge count increases, and passes cleanly when edge counts are equal to or lower than baseline so cycle-breaking changes can land and tighten the baseline. Include unit tests on synthetic import graphs verifying regressions fail and edge removals pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Locking current package cycle edge counts prevents cross-layer coupling regressions while unblocking incremental cycle removal.
acceptance_criteria: CI fails if any new package import cycle is introduced or if any existing cycle's edge count increases; removing edges passes cleanly and allows lowering the ratchet baseline.
apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py passes uv run pytest apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py and uv run task lint.
